modules.name: Concentrated Cyber-Infrastructure Fragility
modules.velocity: Critical - API authorization vulnerabilities enable rapid exploitation of trust at critical financial nodes, independent of supply chain dependencies, increasing the frequency of specific institutional shocks.
modules.inertia: Critical - API security patches require fundamental architectural changes in legacy banking stacks, creating resistance to rapid adaptation similar to OS vulnerabilities.

evidence_signals.title: Global IT Outage Cripples Banks and Hospitals
evidence_signals.content: A flawed update from a dominant cybersecurity firm crashed millions of devices globally. The event halted flights and disrupted digital banking liquidity, exposing the systemic fragility of heavily concentrated tech supply chains in the financial sector.

evidence_signals.title: Deepfake CFO Scam Steals $25M
evidence_signals.content: A multinational firm in Hong Kong lost $25M after an employee was tricked by an AI deepfake video call mimicking the CFO. The event highlighted how rapid AI advancements are creating unprecedented fraud and operational risks for corporate finance.

evidence_signals.title: Ransomware Attack Paralyzes Healthcare Payments
evidence_signals.content: A massive ransomware attack on Change Healthcare halted billions in insurance payments. The ensuing liquidity crisis for healthcare providers demonstrated how cyber vulnerabilities in third-party tech vendors can cascade into direct economic shocks.

evidence_signals.title: Major Port Bridge Collapse Severs Auto Supply Chain
evidence_signals.content: A cargo ship power failure led to the collapse of a critical bridge, entirely blocking a major US port. The infrastructure failure severely disrupted auto and coal supply chains, adding another vector to the global logistics crisis.

evidence_signals.title: Ransomware Attack on ICBC Halts US Treasury Settlements
evidence_signals.content: A ransomware attack on the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC) disrupted the settlement of US Treasury trades. The incident exposed how local infrastructure failures at a major foreign bank can lock up critical market payment liquidity.

evidence_signals.title: CrowdStrike Glitch Halts London Stock Exchange Trading
evidence_signals.content: A faulty automatic security update from CrowdStrike corrupted millions of Windows instances globally. The resulting blue-screen failures halted the London Stock Exchange, cancelled thousands of flights, and highlighted the extreme concentration risk in IT.

evidence_signals.title: Cybersecurity Deficiencies Exposed at Major Digital Ledger Bank
evidence_signals.content: A central digital asset custodian bank disclosed a severe API authorization vulnerability that briefly exposed deposit logs. While no funds were lost, the exposure sparked severe trust degradation regarding digital infrastructure integrity.

modules.certainty_level: High - High-trust reporting confirms API vulnerabilities exist at digital asset custodians, validating the systemic nature of infrastructure risk beyond supply chain issues.
modules.novelty_rationale: Represents a structural shift from external cyber attack vectors to internal supply chain collapse mechanisms where a single vendor update failure triggers macroeconomic liquidity freezes across multiple critical sectors simultaneously.
